descriptions: The student inserts the paper stack into the paper tray of the printer.
The student adds the test page to the printer's tray.
The student inspects the ink cartridge.

study: In 60 descriptions from 10 other recordings, the word-count model ranked the matching moment first 23.9% of the time and attention did so 23.6%. A comparison that matched words to duration, timing and tracking coverage reached 35.6% without using hand coordinates. Random ordering reached 20.7%. These scores give equal weight to each of six acquisition-code groups. This five-moment printer example was part of training.
